chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: Lil Armstrong and Rockwell steer Louis toward money
summary: Marge says Lil wanted Louis to commercialize, and was unhappy to see them the night Zutty confronted Louis; Lil said she would straighten the record in her book but never did.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: And Lil was a big influence. She would commercialize Louis too you know. She loved Zutty, Lille did. But I know when Rockwell told him how much money he could make, and I know Lil was for that you know. Naturally, because when we went down there that night Lil didn't look like she was too happy to see us when we walked in. Because Zutty was going to make Louis tell him.
And she said she was going to straighten that out in her book.
About business is one thing because she heard it.
I guess she never did get to writing the book or anything. She was supposed to straighten that out.
